article.story: ANNAPOLIS, Md. -- — Aidan Kehoe scored 23 points and grabbed 11 rebounds as Navy beat Lafayette 76-50 on Saturday. Jordan Pennick scored 20 points for the Midshipmen (12-5, 4-0 Patriot League). Austin Benigni finished with 17 points. The Midshipmen extended their winning streak to eight games. The Leopards (4-13, 1-3) were led in scoring by Christian Humphrey, who finished with nine points and six rebounds. Mark Butler added eight points and two steals for Lafayette. Andrew Phillips finished with seven points. Kehoe scored 13 pints to help Navy build a 39-20 halftime lead. Pennick scored 11 points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
